name: week
title: Monday pipeline meeting
subtitle: Open deals, what has gone quiet and what is due this week

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select item, issue, detail from v_attention order by issue, item

sections.title: Open pipeline
sections.sql: select deal, company, stage, owner, days_in_stage, days_quiet, next_step, next_step_due from v_pipeline order by array_position(array['sourced','first meeting','diligence','ic','term sheet'], stage), days_in_stage desc

sections.title: Due in the next seven days
sections.sql: select deal, owner, next_step, next_step_due from v_pipeline where next_step_due <= current_date + 7 order by next_step_due

sections.title: Who has reported
sections.sql: select company, owner, last_period, last_received, next_due, reporting from v_portfolio order by next_due nulls first

sections.title: Commitments by status
sections.note: Each currency is its own line. Nothing is converted.
sections.sql: select fund, currency, status, investors, amount from v_fundraise order by fund, currency, status

sections.title: Investor certificates
sections.sql: select investor, fund, status, certificate, certificate_on, relied_on_until, certificate_state from v_certificates order by relied_on_until nulls first

sections.title: Findings
sections.note: Record checks against the rules in docs/compliance.md. Not legal advice.
sections.sql: select rule, item, finding from v_compliance order by rule, item

sections.title: Where deals come from
sections.sql: select * from v_sources order by invested desc, reached_diligence desc
